name: mirenda
description: Mobile-first cloud browser inside a browser, on Cloudflare Workers.

scripts.dev:sandbox: npm run build:sandbox-assets && npm run dev:sandbox -w @mirenda/worker
scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run build:extensions && npm run build:sandbox-assets
scripts.build:extensions: npm run build -w @mirenda/eruda-devtools && npm run build -w @mirenda/cookie-manager && npm run build -w @mirenda/js-css-studio
scripts.build:sandbox-assets: rm -rf apps/worker/sandbox-assets && mkdir -p apps/worker/sandbox-assets && cp -R apps/web/dist/extensions apps/worker/sandbox-assets/extensions
